mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO td_bar (id, symbol, "interval", bar_time, open, high, low, close, adj_close, volume, amount, currency) VALUES
(#{bar.id}, #{bar.symbol}, #{bar.interval}, #{bar.barTime}, #{bar.open}, #{bar.high}, #{bar.low}, #{bar.close}, #{bar.adjClose}, #{bar.volume}, #{bar.amount}, #{bar.currency})
ON CONFLICT (symbol, "interval", bar_time) DO UPDATE SET open = EXCLUDED.open, high = EXCLUDED.high, low = EXCLUDED.low, close = EXCLUDED.close, adj_close = EXCLUDED.adj_close, volume = EXCLUDED.volume, amount = EXCLUDED.amount, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, symbol, "interval", bar_time, open, high, low, close, adj_close, volume, amount, currency, created_at, updated_at FROM td_bar WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND "interval" = #{interval} ORDER BY bar_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY t.bar_time ASC
